0.

FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part 1 ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 31 July 1984, after the draft finalized by the Connectors for Electronic Equipment Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. 0.2 This standard 1980*. ( Part 1 ) shall be used in conjunction with IS : 5054-

0.3 This standard ( Part 1 ) is one of the series of standards on radio frequency connectors for frequencies above 3 MHz used in electronic This is the sectional specification covering BNC, TNC and equipment. Subsequent parts of this standard would cover UHF series of connectors. detail specifications for specific types of connectors. 0.4 While preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from ` Detail specification for connectors, radio frequency, series JSS 52401 issued by the Directorate of Standardization, BNC, TNC and UHF' Ministry of Defence, India. 0.3 For the purpose of deciding whether standard is complied with, the final value the result of the test shall be rounded off A number of significant places retained be the same as that of the specified value a particular requirement of this observed or calculated, expressing in accordance with IS : Z-1960t. in the rounded off value should in this standard.
